title: Canonical transition map of higher direct images of abelian etale sheaves
statement: Let $a:Y'\to Y$, $h:Y\to S$, and $h':Y'\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with $h\circ a=h'$. Let $F$ and $F'$ be abelian etale sheaves on $Y$ and $Y'$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and let $\varphi:a^{-1}F\to F'$ use inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For $p\geq0$, the canonical transition morphism $R^p h_* F\to R^p h'_*F'$ of the derived direct images [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is degree-$p$ cohomology of the derived adjunction unit $Rh_*F\to Rh'_*Lh'^*Rh_*F$, followed by the pullback composition identification $Lh'^*=La^*Lh^*$, $Rh'_*La^*$ applied to the counit $Lh^*Rh_*F\to F$, the identification $La^*(F[0])=(a^{-1}F)[0]$, and $Rh'_*(\varphi[0])$.
